issues.where: the right-hand mountains above and below the east–west valley
issues.what: the long, nearly parallel ridges recur at the same spacing and repeat the same feathered side gullies, making the mountain chain look stamped
issues.fix: break the spacing and alignment, and vary ridge length, branching and summit shape across the chain

issues.where: the broad field of white flecks over the left-hand water; also visible in set-A-05.png and set-A-08.png
issues.what: the bright layer breaks up into dense, isolated white dots and blobs, reading as sprayed paint rather than a continuous physical surface or volume
issues.fix: resolve the flecks into coherent structures with graded edges and depth; if they are surface highlights, tie them to wave crests and the lighting direction

issues.where: the three pale trails in the upper-right crop
issues.what: the trails have nearly identical widths and parallel starts, then break into flat white fragments instead of thinning into translucent vapor
issues.fix: give each plume a different width and opacity, and let the trails thin and mix gradually with the surrounding air

issues.where: the central crater lake and its ochre perimeter; the lake interior is shown at native size in set-A-02.png and set-A-03.png
issues.what: the smooth ochre band wraps around most of the basin, then feathers into a nearly uniform navy center, giving the shoreline and depth a painted look
issues.fix: vary the shore transition with the basin topography, break up the sediment band at inlets and shelves, and add restrained surface detail

issues.where: the north inlet in the upper-right crop
issues.what: the river is a smooth teal ribbon with almost constant width and a clean edge even as the terrain changes around it
issues.fix: fit it to the valley floor and vary channel width, banks and shallows at bends and where it enters the lake

issues.where: the pale crests in the right crop
issues.what: the pale ridge texture smears across the slope breaks at native size, obscuring where the ridges turn into rock faces
issues.fix: add terrain detail that follows slope and erosion, and sharpen the actual crest geometry rather than the whole image

issues.where: the orange points among the ridges in the lower-left crop
issues.what: the points have tiny halos but no visible interaction with adjacent terrain or haze, so they look placed over the image
issues.fix: if they are meant to be luminous, anchor each to a visible feature and give the brightest point subtle spill on the nearest slope or haze
